title: New Line will not save without a Title and shows "Title is a required field"
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154709 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154709 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. Click New Line.
  3. Leave the Title field empty.
  4. Type a description in the Description field (for example ZZAUTOTEST no title).
  5. Click Save & Close.
  6. Read the message under the Title field.
  7. Close the window without saving.
  8. Read the lines listed on the Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the window stays open and the line is not saved.
  • Step 6: the message under Title reads exactly "Title is a required field" (not "Line Name is a required field").
  • Step 8: no new line with the typed description is listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S1-R6, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (New Line - after), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-004; Product comment by Chris Ward, 23 Sep 2026 (Confluence comment 883261444); Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R6: “Leaving Title empty blocks the save with the message "Title is a required field", replacing "Line Name is a required field". Every required-field message in the app uses the "X is a required field" form, and this one keeps it.”
  • Tech plan FR-004: “Empty Title blocks save with exactly "Title is a required field" (S1-R6, as updated by Product 2026-09-23).”
